description: Public Utilities Commission - Amendment to the definition for consumers of electricity to be qualified under the "Industry" category published under Section 9 of "Decision" on Electricity Tariffs 2013
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of a regulatory definition under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009. It concerns the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka exercising its statutory powers to modify the classification of electricity consumers for tariff purposes, which falls under legal/regulatory framework modifications rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
